# Sixth Gear

> Sixth Gear is an AI automation and transformation partner. We build, run, and continuously optimise AI workflows against the KPIs that matter to your business, so your team can grow bigger, not busier.

Sixth Gear is an AI automation and transformation partner. It designs, builds, runs and continuously optimises AI workflows for businesses, measured against each client's own KPIs. Tagline: "Your business, in a higher gear."

## What Sixth Gear does
- **AI workflow automation**: We design and build AI workflows that take over repetitive, manual work across support, operations and back-office processes.
- **Managed AI operations**: We run your AI workflows in production and continuously optimise them against the KPIs you care about, such as turnaround time, cost per task and hours saved.
- **AI support agents**: AI agents that handle routine customer support queries and investigate issues, with humans reviewing the work that matters.
- **Free AI transformation workshop**: A free worksheet-led workshop to identify bottlenecks, assess readiness and risks, build a cost and outcome case, and plan a pilot.

## Outcomes Sixth Gear delivers
- 24/7 operational coverage
- 10+ hours saved per employee per week
- 3× more workflows handled per team
- 80% of routine support queries handled by AI
- 2× faster turnaround
- 50% less manual processing

## Case studies
- **Customer Service, 4× faster support investigation.** An AI support agent that investigates bugs, reproduces issues in a sandbox, and prepares tested fixes as draft PRs for engineering review.
- **Field Operations, 65% less manual data entry.** An AI-powered workflow that brings field data capture, rule-based calculations, and report drafting into one streamlined process.

## Platforms and models used
Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, ElevenLabs, Typesafe, Google Cloud, AWS, Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, Salesforce.

## Free AI transformation workshop
The free worksheet helps teams:
01. Identify bottlenecks and map the workflow
02. Assess readiness and risks
03. Build a case estimating costs and outcomes
04. Plan the pilot

## Relevant topics
AI transformation, AI workflow automation, business process automation with AI, AI agents for customer support, AI for field operations, managed AI operations for business workflows, KPI-driven AI implementation, AI readiness assessment, AI pilot planning.
